schema.description:
An RFC 9457 problem details object with problem-specific extension members.

Serialization includes `type`, `title`, and `status`, plus `detail` and `instance` when
supplied.

detail.description:
A human-readable explanation of this occurrence that helps the client correct the problem.
Use extension members for structured information.
examples: This operation requires a machine actor.

instance.description:
A URI reference identifying this occurrence. It may identify the occurrence without
resolving to further information.

status.description: The HTTP status code sent with this occurrence.

title.description:
A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. Keep it the same across occurrences,
except for localization.

type.description:
A URI reference identifying the problem type. Use `about:blank` when the HTTP status code
fully describes the problem type. If `type` is omitted during deserialization, it defaults
to `about:blank`.

schema.title: Problem Details

AuthenticationRejected.description: The credentials cannot resolve to a permitted caller.

schema.title: Problem Details

RateLimited.description: The request exceeds its rate limit.

id.description: The UUID of a machine actor.
The UUID of an AI agent.

actor.description: The resolved actor, or `null` for an anonymous request.

delegatedActor.description: Delegated actor UUID, used with the service credential. The nil UUID resolves as anonymous.
delegatedActor.name: X-Authenticated-User-Actor-Id

serviceSecret.description: Enter the complete Authorization header value: `HASH-Service <secret>`. Include the `HASH-Service` prefix; the client sends this value unchanged. Requires the `X-Authenticated-User-Actor-Id` header to name the delegated actor.
serviceSecret.name: authorization

info.description:
Errors use RFC 9457 Problem Details with the `application/problem+json` media type.

Replacing `about:blank` with a specific problem type URI is a non-breaking change. Clients should handle unrecognized problem types using the HTTP status code.
info.title: Types

get.description: Returns the resolved actor, or `actor: null` for an anonymous request.
